entries.title: Social feed carousel widget.
entries.notes: Capture a public page with seeded cached feed items rendered through the social-feed block using the carousel layout.
entries.useCase: A visitor sees a branded carousel of social posts without exposing feed connection internals.

entries.title: RSS feed sync and cached items.
entries.notes: Capture after creating an RSS connection, running the sync action, and confirming cached items exist for render.
entries.useCase: An administrator verifies an RSS feed is connected and producing cached social feed items.

entries.title: Provider registry extension surface.
entries.notes: Capture package documentation or diagnostics output showing built-in RSS, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, and a custom provider.
entries.useCase: A developer confirms social feeds can be extended without coupling their provider package to package internals.
